subject: $19 vs the alternatives
preheader: what underwriting actually costs when truecap isn't doing it.
headline: Pro is $19/mo. Here's what the same job costs everywhere else.
body: A single hour of a real estate analyst's time runs $150-300. A custom underwriting model from a freelance modeler on Upwork: $400-1,200 one-time. A single appraisal: $500-700. A bad inspector who misses something on a deal you actually bought: easily $10,000+. Underwriting isn't free anywhere. It's just usually invisible.

TrueCap Pro is $19/month or $228/year. Annual is roughly two months free. No flash sale, no expiring discount, no fake urgency timer. The price has been the same for a while and will probably stay that way.

What you get: unlimited address analyses, MAO calculator, sensitivity grids, BRRRR analyzer, fix-and-flip analyzer, PDF reports with your branding, saved deals across devices, mortgage scenario A/B compare, rehab estimator. Cancel anytime. Prorated refund on the unused portion of an annual plan.

Most people underestimate the per-deal cost of doing nothing. Every 30-minute spreadsheet underwrite costs you 30 minutes you could've spent finding three more deals to filter. Over a year of active analysis, that's a hundred hours of opportunity cost. $228 to get those hundred hours back is the trade.
If you've gotten value from the free tier, Pro is the same tool with the locks off. The pricing page lists everything.
